story_description: Implement all settings category views and their entry points.

atom_description: Users need to configure terminal appearance including backend selection, font, size, cursor style, and scrollback.
problem_statement: Users need to configure terminal appearance including backend selection, font, size, cursor style, and scrollback.
scope_in: Backend picker (SwiftTerm/Ghostty); font picker; font size; cursor style; scrollback lines
Implement TerminalSettingsView.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Ghostty option disabled if not available
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
nonfunctional_requirements: Must not block the main UI thread.
implementation_steps: Add backend picker with availability check
Add font picker with system font enumeration
api_contracts: Primary API surface is the TerminalSettingsView.swift type and its public members.

event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_states: Ghostty selected: May show warning if unavailable
Font preview: Shows sample text in selected font
edge_cases: Ghostty unavailable - option disabled with explanation
Font not available - fall back to system monospace
Scrollback too large - warn about memory usage
failure_modes: Selected font missing - use system monospace
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
